module: "Test" tab of the rally editor (debug tool). The module returns a class C constructor. It offers a "Test 1" button (prints a random "precountdown" system pacenote to the log), "Load Recce Mission" (reloads the gameplay_rally_recceApp extension and loads the mission) and "Unload Recce Mission".
notes: No exported function: you get an instance with require(...)(rallyEditor).
self.driveline is initialized to nil and is no longer used (driveline loading was removed).

C.desc: Test tab instance, created by the constructor returned by the module (calls init). Has windowDescription = 'Test'.

selected.desc: Called by the rally editor when the tab is selected; re-emits the onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil) hook to redraw the shortcut legend.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left; also emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

draw.desc: Draws the three test buttons (imgui). Does nothing without a notebook.

test1.desc: Prints to the console the name of a random system pacenote of type 'precountdown' (path:getRandomSystemPacenote).

drawDebugEntrypoint.desc: 3D view debug drawing entry point; empty here.
